start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:send-the-link-to-each-keyword-commenter." The wake runs it every ten minutes once its store names and account are given as its input.
no_lists_because: The workflow reads the owner's reply rules and writes the owner's replies-kept rows through their database tools; it needs no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Give the wake its input when you switch it on: the store the reply rules live in, the store the replies are kept in, and the account's handle and media endpoints. The file carries only the start step.
2. Say "Run workflow:send-the-link-to-each-keyword-commenter" (the wake does this every ten minutes).
3. Read the replies it sent; a comment already in the replies-kept rows is never sent twice.

worked_examples.title: A comment with a keyword gets the link once
worked_examples.given: A comment on one of the 10 newest posts contains a reply rule's keyword and no reply has been kept for it.
worked_examples.hands_back: A quoted "message_id" comes back from the send, and the replies-kept row for that comment reads state "sent".
